case_name: Add a logo or text overlay
title: Append a Clean End Card
tests: Tests appending an accurately timed end card with exact text while preserving the complete source clip and its audio.

exact_text.read_as: y for tak… (cropped at both sides)

faults.what: The end card is already visible at 5.6 seconds, before the full seven-second source clip should have finished.
Both end-card lines are oversized and cut off at the left and right edges, making the requested wording impossible to read in full.
The landscape source has been reframed into a tightly cropped portrait output, removing substantial cockpit content without being requested.

judge.summary: The nine-second output includes cockpit footage and a black end card, but the card appears too early and its oversized text is severely cropped.

must_haves.item: The entire original cockpit clip plays before the end card, without being replaced or shortened.
must_haves.why: The end card is already present at 5.6 seconds, so the original seven-second clip cannot play in full before it.

must_haves.item: A solid black end card occupies only the final 2 seconds of the 9-second output.
must_haves.why: The black end card is visible at both 5.6 and 7.9 seconds, rather than being restricted to seconds seven through nine.

must_haves.item: The end card reads exactly 'Ready for takeoff?' with '@flightschool' on the line below.
must_haves.why: Two text lines are present, but both are horizontally clipped and neither complete requested string is visible.

must_haves.item: Both lines are white, centered, fully visible, and comfortably readable.
must_haves.why: The letters are white, but the text is far too large to fit within the frame.

must_haves.item: Original cockpit audio is preserved during the source footage, followed by silence during the end card.
must_haves.why: The transcript confirms speech in the output but does not establish preservation of the complete source audio or silence during the end card.
